Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object

Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

```
import os,glob,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])   # this instance's own log: the folder keeps every earlier one's
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
```

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r if v)
    B=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cols=[c for c in range(W) if any(g[r][c]==B for r in range(H))]
    rows=[r for r in range(H) if any(g[r][c]==B for c in range(W))]
    def ivs(idx):
        out=[];s=idx[0];p=idx[0]
        for x in idx[1:]:
            if x==p+1: p=x
            else: out.append((s,p)); s=p=x
        out.append((s,p)); return out
    civ=ivs(cols); riv=ivs(rows)
    fills={}
    for bi,(r0,r1) in enumerate(riv):
        for bj,(c0,c1) in enumerate(civ):
            inner=[g[r][c] for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1) if g[r][c] not in (0,B)]
            if inner: fills[(bi,bj)]=Counter(inner).most_common(1)[0][0]
    def inany(x,ivs_): return any(a<=x<=b for a,b in ivs_)
    bycol={}
    for k,v in fills.items(): bycol.setdefault(v,[]).append(k)
    for colr,bl in bycol.items():
        if len(bl)!=4: continue
        rs=sorted({b[0] for b in bl}); cs=sorted({b[1] for b in bl})
        if len(rs)!=2 or len(cs)!=2: continue
        if sorted(bl)!=[(rs[0],cs[0]),(rs[0],cs[1]),(rs[1],cs[0]),(rs[1],cs[1])]: continue
        (rA0,rA1),(rB0,rB1)=riv[rs[0]],riv[rs[1]]
        (cA0,cA1),(cB0,cB1)=civ[cs[0]],civ[cs[1]]
        gc=[c for c in range(cA0,cB1+1) if not inany(c,civ)]
        gr=[r for r in range(rA0,rB1+1) if not inany(r,riv)]
        for r in list(range(rA0+1,rA1))+list(range(rB0+1,rB1)):
            for c in gc: g[r][c]=colr
        for c in list(range(cA0+1,cA1))+list(range(cB0+1,cB1)):
            for r in gr: g[r][c]=colr
